001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.inventory;
002
003import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.event.AbstractQSEvent;
004import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop.Shop;
005import lombok.Data;
006import lombok.EqualsAndHashCode;
007
008/**
009 * Fire when shop inventory space/stock calculating.
010 */
011@EqualsAndHashCode(callSuper = true)
012@Data
013public class ShopInventoryCalculateEvent extends AbstractQSEvent {
014
015  private final Shop shop;
016  private final int space;
017  private final int stock;
018
019  public ShopInventoryCalculateEvent(final Shop shop, final int space, final int stock) {
020
021    this.shop = shop;
022    this.space = space;
023    this.stock = stock;
024  }
025
026  /**
027   * Gets the shop that inventory has been calculated
028   *
029   * @return The shop
030   */
031  public Shop getShop() {
032
033    return shop;
034  }
035
036  /**
037   * Getting the inventory space
038   *
039   * @return The inventory space (-1 if not get calculated)
040   */
041  public int getSpace() {
042
043    return space;
044  }
045
046  /**
047   * Getting the inventory stock
048   *
049   * @return The inventory stock (-1 if not get calculated)
050   */
051  public int getStock() {
052
053    return stock;
054  }
055}
